d:
Jharkhand: nabalig aadivasi larki se yaun shoshan ka aarop, bhushan bara par kya bole babulal marandi?
Jharkhand men kangres vidhayak bhushan bara par nabalig aadivasi larki se kathit yaun shoshan ke aaropon ko lekar siyasat tej ho gaee hai.neta pratipaksh aur bhajpa neta babulal marandi ne bhushan bara ki tatkal giraphtari ki mang ki hai. pirita ne apni shikayat men vidhayak par ganbhir aarop lagae hain, vahin, bhushan bara ne in aaropon ko kharij karte hue rajnitik sajish bataya hai. is mamle men pulis janch jari hai. dekhie is pure mamle par babulal marandi ne kya kaha?
